title: The Sons of Yahya bin Khalid and Said bin Salim
logline: A man drowning in debt asks two great brothers for help, gets only a prayer, and goes away crushed; that same day mules loaded with money arrive at his door, because the brothers had gone quietly to the caliph.
moral: True generosity works in silence: judge people by what they do, not by what they say or do not say to your face.
tone: Warm comic drama. Gentle comedy of embarrassment in the first half (the pile of bills, the creditors, the empty palm), then a joyful reversal. The brothers are dignified, never mocked; the joke is on Said's fear.

beats.summary: Said ibn Salim of Baghdad, a respectable man.
Debts pile up on him, bill by bill.
Creditors come to his door every day; he is trapped.
He asks Abdullah ibn Malik for a way out.
Advice: only the Barmakid family can help.
Said fears haughty words and empty hands.
Abdullah: bear what you hear to save your house. Said decides to go.
He visits al-Fadl and Jaafar and tells his story.
But they hand him no money. His fear seems true.
The servant bursts in: loaded mules and a letter at the door.
He opens the letter with a trembling hand.
Each brother adds a million of his own.
They worked in secret so the help would be greater.

camera.notes: Track with Said along the 1600 strip from camX 0 to 600 (zoom 1.1), then push to zoom 1.9 on his hands and the letter (centre 1180,700) from 125.1.

scenes.composition: Street in warm late light (palette 'dusk'). Four mules stand in a line at x 300, 520, 740, 960 facing right; the creditors stand behind them at x 420, 640, 860 (drawn before the mules); messenger at the door x 1160; Said stops at x 1080.

actions.action: Said runs in from the left, robe flying, the servant behind him
actions.acting: run cycle, tip 0.12, arms pumping, eyes on the door

actions.action: he passes the mules: each turns its head and flicks its ears as he goes by
actions.acting: earL/earR keyed per mule, headTurn 0.3, tails swish

actions.action: the three creditors stare at the chests with their mouths open, bills forgotten at their sides
actions.acting: eyes wide, mouths 'o', heads follow Said then snap back to the chests

actions.action: he brakes at his own door in front of the messenger
actions.acting: lurch(t, 124.36), heels dig in, dust

actions.action: the messenger bows and hands him the sealed scroll
actions.acting: handOver: the scroll follows his hand to Said's; both gazes on it

actions.action: Said breaks the red seal and unrolls the letter
actions.acting: thumbs push the roll open (open 0 to 1), eyes scanning the first line

actions.action: close on his hands: they shake, and the paper shakes with them
actions.acting: tremble(t, 3) on both hands and the scroll, a gulp, wet eyes begin

scenes.summary: Inside the letter: the brothers told the caliph about Said. He ordered one million dirhams for the debt, then added three hundred thousand to live on.

camera.notes: Match cut from the open letter to the same framing inside a scroll frame (letterFrame rollers top and bottom of the panel). Zoom 1.1; push to 1.3 on the caliph for the order at 133.4.

scenes.composition: Caliph on the throne at right (HALL.throne anchor). Brothers stand at x 360 (Fadl) and x 460 (Jaafar) facing him. Amount tags stack at left, x 90..330, from y 420 downward, clear of all faces.

actions.action: the letter's paper grows to fill the panel; its wavy lines dissolve into the caliph's hall, framed by the scroll rollers
actions.acting: the picture draws on left to right like ink (a clip wipe)

actions.action: the two brothers walk in side by side and bow to the caliph
actions.acting: purposeful walk, Fadl half a step ahead; tip 0.25 bow with settle

actions.action: Jaafar speaks while Fadl holds up a portrait medallion of Said
actions.acting: talk 0.8, PERSON_HANDS.palmsUp; caliph's gaze goes to the medallion

actions.action: the caliph leans forward on the throne to look
actions.acting: tip 0.08, brow -0.3, hand to beard

actions.action: a small stack of bills pops beside Said's portrait
actions.acting: the portrait's eyes look at the stack and its brow rises

actions.action: the caliph raises his hand and points: so be it
actions.acting: anticipation dip, then PERSON_HANDS.pointFwd with overshoot; brow level, decisive

actions.action: tag 1 slams in at left: 1,000,000 with a chest icon
actions.acting: pop state with overshoot; the brothers' heads turn to it

actions.action: label under the tag: FOR THE DEBT
actions.acting: the bill stack beside Said's portrait gets a red strike through it

actions.action: the caliph pauses, thinks, then lifts a second finger
actions.acting: gaze up for a beat (thinking), small smile, PERSON_HANDS.pointUp

actions.action: tag 2 pops under the first: 300,000 with a sack icon
actions.acting: the brothers glance at each other, pleased (first smiles we see on them)

actions.action: label under tag 2: TO LIVE ON
actions.acting: Said's portrait smiles

actions.action: the brothers bow again, deeper
actions.acting: tip 0.3, Jaafar a beat late; caliph nods

scenes.summary: Still inside the letter: each brother adds another million from his own money.

camera.notes: Inside the same letterFrame. Zoom 1.3 on the open vault door and the two brothers; tags continue the column at left.

scenes.composition: Vault door open at right (palaceHall vault option). Fadl at x 470, Jaafar at x 640, each beside his own chest on the floor. Tags 3 and 4 at left under the first two.

actions.action: at their own hall the vault door swings open; al-Fadl carries out a chest and sets it down
actions.acting: weight: knees bend, sq 0.94 on the set-down, the chest lid bounces

actions.action: Jaafar carries out a second chest and sets it beside the first
actions.acting: a little quicker and prouder than his brother; small smile

actions.action: tag 3 pops: 1,000,000 with al-Fadl's medallion
actions.acting: Fadl pats his own chest once

actions.action: tag 4 pops: 1,000,000 with Jaafar's medallion
actions.acting: Jaafar pats his own chest; the brothers look at each other

actions.action: Jaafar puts a finger to his lips; Fadl nods
actions.acting: PERSON_HANDS.hush, wink R; conspirators' smiles

scenes.summary: The total: three million three hundred thousand dirhams. The mules are unloaded at Said's door and the creditors are paid.

camera.notes: Match cut out of the letter to Said holding it at his door (zoom 1.7), then pull out to zoom 1.05 on the whole door, mules and growing heap by 153.0.

scenes.composition: Said at x 1080 by his door. The four tags sit in a column at top left of the panel (panel space), the running total in a counter box under them. Chest heap grows at x 880..1040 beside the door. Creditors queue at x 520..760.

actions.action: Said lowers the letter; his eyes come up over its edge, brimming
actions.acting: wet: true, brow -0.7, mouth trembling into a smile

actions.action: the four tags fly out of the letter and stack as a column at top left
actions.acting: each lands with a 2-frame stagger; Said's eyes follow them up

actions.action: the servant and the messenger lift chests off the first mule and set them by the door
actions.acting: mule rises 6 units as the load leaves (sq 1.04), ear flick

actions.action: the counter under the column rolls up through the millions: 1,000,000 ... 3,000,000
actions.acting: digits spin; Said's head tips back a little further with each million

actions.action: the counter lands on 3,300,000 with a flash
actions.acting: Said claps both hands to his cheeks

actions.action: Said hands the first creditor a fat purse; the creditor's bill gets a red strike and he bows
actions.acting: creditor1 brow flips from 0.8 to -0.4, smile; creditors 2 and 3 hold out their hands eagerly

actions.action: label DIRHAMS pops beside the total
actions.acting: coins glint on the heap

scenes.summary: Said understands: the brothers did not stop at kind words but worked in secret so the help would be greater than he expected. A new life begins. THE END.

camera.notes: Medium on Said with the thought cloud above (zoom 1.5) until 165.6; then a slow pull-out and tilt to the full heap towering over him (zoom 1.0) by 168.3; hold for THE END.

scenes.composition: Thought cloud (520 x 360) at top centre. After the pull-out: Said small at x 1080, the chest heap at x 840..1040 rising to y 560 (taller than him), his door open and lit behind him, the sky turning to morning.

actions.action: the last two creditors take their purses, bow and walk off left; the street clears
actions.acting: struck bills flutter down behind them; they leave at different speeds

actions.action: Said looks down at the letter, then up, and it dawns on him
actions.acting: gaze letter, then far off; brow lifts slowly, mouth opens: the realisation

actions.action: thought cloud pops: the two brothers seated as he saw them
actions.acting: cloud figures level and calm, exactly the S8 poses (setup and payoff)

actions.action: in the cloud: they raise their hands in the same prayer as before
actions.acting: the S8 prayer pose copied exactly

actions.action: in the cloud: the moment cloud-Said turns away, the brothers spring up
actions.acting: anticipation crouch then stand; quick look at each other

actions.action: in the cloud: they tiptoe off right with a scroll, Jaafar's finger on his lips
actions.acting: sneak steps (short stride, high knees), PERSON_HANDS.hush, wink

actions.action: the cloud pops; camera pulls out and tilts up the heap of chests and sacks beside Said
actions.acting: the heap is revealed bottom to top; coins glint in turn

actions.action: Said looks up, and up, to the top of the heap, taller than he is
actions.acting: head tips back (tip -0.1), turban nearly slides off; he catches it

actions.action: he laughs and gives a little hop of joy
actions.acting: anticipate, hop 30 units, landSquash; eyes shut smiling, one happy tear

actions.action: the sky behind the roofs turns from dusk to a fresh morning; Said's door swings wide and his window shutters open
actions.acting: warm light spills from the door

actions.action: Said lifts both hands in thanks toward the sky
actions.acting: PERSON_HANDS.palmsUp raised, gaze up, wet eyes, peaceful smile

actions.action: the servant leads the last mule in through the open door; Said follows and turns on the threshold to wave
actions.acting: mule walks without sliding, ears up; Said's wave has a settle

actions.action: THE END title pops over the morning sky, top of panel
actions.acting: Said holds the wave, blinking; mule tail swishes; held to 174.9

actions.action: he steps inside and the door closes gently on the new day
actions.acting: last look to camera, smile; door eases shut by 174.6

ending.description: After the last word (171.62) Said waves from his open, lit doorway under a fresh morning sky, the heap of chests beside him and the last mule going in. THE END pops at 172.2 at the top of the panel and is held to 174.9 while he steps inside and the door eases shut.

subtitles.ar: كان سعيد بن سالم يعيش في زمن الخليفة هارون الرشيد،|وقد تراكمت عليه ديون كثيرة.|صار الدائنون يأتون إلى بابه كل يوم، ويطالبونه بأموالهم،|حتى ضاقت به السبل ولم يعرف من أين يبدأ.
subtitles.en: Said ibn Salim lived in Harun al-Rashid’s time|and had fallen deep into debt.|Creditors crowded his door daily,|leaving him desperate.

subtitles.ar: ذهب إلى رجل يعرفه اسمه عبد الله بن مالك،|وسأله عن طريقة للخروج من محنته.|قال عبد الله إن أحدًا لا يستطيع أن يساعده مثل أسرة البرامكة،|وإن عليه أن يطلب عونها.
subtitles.en: He sought advice from Abdullah ibn Malik,|who said only the powerful Barmakid family|could rescue him|from his debts.

subtitles.ar: تردد سعيد،|وقال إنه يخشى أن يقابله أبناؤها بكلام متعالٍ ولا يعطوه شيئًا.|أجابه عبد الله بأن عليه أن يحتمل ما يسمعه،|ما دام يريد إنقاذ بيته من الدائنين المتجمعين حوله.
subtitles.en: Said hesitated,|afraid the brothers would treat him arrogantly.|Abdullah advised him to endure any unpleasantness|if it meant escaping his creditors.

subtitles.ar: زار سعيد الفضل وجعفر، وهما ابنا يحيى بن خالد،|وحكى لهما حاله.|سمعا كلامه، ودعوا الله أن يفرج كربه ويرزقه الغنى،|لكنهما لم يسلماه مالًا وهو جالس أمامهما.
subtitles.en: Said visited al-Fadl and Jaafar, Yahya’s sons,|and explained his plight.|They prayed that God would relieve him,|but handed him no money.

subtitles.ar: خرج سعيد حزينًا، وعاد إلى عبد الله يشكو أن الزيارة لم تنفعه.|دعاه عبد الله إلى الجلوس بقية اليوم، لعل شيئًا يتغير.|جلس الرجل مهمومًا،|وهو يفكر في الديون التي تنتظره في البيت.
subtitles.en: Disappointed, Said returned to Abdullah and complained.|Abdullah asked him to stay awhile in case help arrived,|and Said sat|worrying about his debts.

subtitles.ar: لم يمر وقت طويل حتى جاء خادم سعيد مسرعًا،|وقال إن عند باب البيت بغالًا كثيرة محملة بالأموال،|ورجلًا يحمل رسالة من الفضل وجعفر.|أسرع سعيد إلى منزله وفتح الرسالة بيد مرتجفة.
subtitles.en: Soon Said’s servant arrived breathlessly:|loaded mules stood outside their house|with a messenger bearing a letter|from the two brothers.

subtitles.ar: كتب الأخوان أنهما أخبرا الخليفة بحاله،|فأمر له بمليون درهم لسداد الدين،|ثم أضاف ثلاثمئة ألف لينفق منها بعد السداد.|وأرسل كل واحد من الأخوين مليونًا آخر من ماله الخاص.
subtitles.en: The letter explained that the caliph|had granted one million dirhams for debts|and three hundred thousand for living expenses.|Each brother also gave a million personally.

subtitles.ar: صار مجموع ما وصل إلى سعيد|ثلاثة ملايين وثلاثمئة ألف درهم.|عندها فهم أن الفضل وجعفر لم يكتفيا بالكلام الطيب،|بل عملا في الخفاء ليكون العون أكبر مما توقع، وليبدأ حياة جديدة.
subtitles.en: Said received|three million three hundred thousand dirhams altogether.|The brothers had worked quietly after his visit|to secure far more help than he imagined.

new_assets.name: mule (donkey option)
new_assets.description: Pack mule as an opt-in option on the Library donkey: mule: true gives ears 70 long (not 110), body scaled 1.12, a full horse-like tail, no white muzzle patch; works with pal, load, silhouette, walk and all acting fields.
new_assets.implementation: In cast/hooves.js read P.mule inside donkey(): scale the ear length constant, body scale and tail shape only when set, so the default donkey is pixel-identical (regression test). Add a catalogue pose.

new_assets.name: letterFrame
new_assets.description: A frame that says "this picture is the letter": rollers 972 x 34 at the top and bottom of the panel (brown with dark dot shading, round caps), a 26 px paper margin left and right, a red wax seal r 22 at lower right; open 0..1 unrolls the picture from the top roller.
new_assets.implementation: Panel-space function letterFrame(ctx, {open}): clip the world draw to the unrolled rect (height = open * panel height), then draw two rounded rects with K halftone dots for the rollers and a circle seal. No tint needed.

new_assets.name: priceTags
new_assets.description: Planned amount tags with a running total (AN-084). States used here: hidden, pop, live, fly (to the column in S16). Tags carry an icon slot (packLoad item or portraitMedallion).
new_assets.implementation: A keyed state table [t, index, state]; each tag is a rounded rect in C.yellow with a brush border and Bangers text (>= 44 px at 1280 scale); pop uses settleTo; the total uses S.counter with kfn on the value.

new_assets.name: iconBalloon
new_assets.description: Planned wordless picture balloon, single and strip modes, drawing reduced Library art inside (townDoor, donkey silhouettes, packLoad, scroll, medallions).
new_assets.implementation: Reuse thoughtCloud's clip-and-scale callback with a speech tail (triangle) instead of bubbles; strip mode is a rounded rect with items popping left to right on cue times.

new_assets.name: portraitMedallion
new_assets.description: Planned round portrait (yellow rim, paper ground with blue dots) of a person head clipped to a circle; eyes can gaze, mouth can change.
new_assets.implementation: Clip a circle, draw person() at a scale and offset that put the head at the centre, stroke the rim.

new_assets.name: scroll
new_assets.description: Planned scroll: bill and letter states (sizes in props), struck and seal options, open 0..1.
new_assets.implementation: Rect with rolled ends (two ellipses), wavy lines with K.noise-free sine strokes, red seal circle, red diagonal for struck.

new_assets.name: coinPile, purse, floorCushion
new_assets.description: Planned small props under their planned names; coinPile gets a silver palette for dirhams.
new_assets.implementation: Flat ellipses in rows for coins; purse as a pear shape with a tie; cushion as the palaceHall dais cushion drawing.

new_assets.name: handOver
new_assets.description: Planned: an object follows hand A, eases to hand B over 0.25 s with a weight dip; both gazes follow (letter in S13, purses in S16 and S17, chests off the mules).
new_assets.implementation: Position = blend of the two persons' P.hands world points with K.ease; add kick() on the receiver.

owner_questions: SCRIPT: P6 English omits the Arabic last sentence (Said hurried home and opened the letter with a trembling hand); both kept verbatim, the last English chunk shows during that sentence.
SCRIPT: P8 English omits the Arabic ending "and to begin a new life"; both kept verbatim.
SCRIPT: P4 English omits "while he sat before them", P5 English says "awhile" where the Arabic says "the rest of the day"; kept verbatim.
Added picture (not in the script): the creditors are shown being paid with purses and their bills struck in S16 and S17; default is to show it, since the letter says the money is for the debt.

Added acting: the brothers exchange one unreadable glance at 72.76 and, inside the letter and the final thought cloud, Jaafar puts a finger to his lips; default is to keep both as the visual form of "worked in secret".

Invented English lettering: SAID, HARUN AL-RASHID'S BAGHDAD, DEBTS!, KNOCK! KNOCK!, DAY 1 to 3, ABDULLAH IBN MALIK, THE BARMAKIDS, HMPH!, NOTHING, AL-FADL, JAAFAR, SONS OF YAHYA, NO MONEY, BANG!, FOR THE DEBT, TO LIVE ON, DIRHAMS, the amounts and the LATER card text SOON...; default is to use them all.
The caliph Harun al-Rashid is drawn as a comic figure on a throne inside the letter; default is to show him (Library caliph preset).
implementation_notes: The DAY 1 to 3 tally (S2) and the amounts on tags 3 and 4 (S15) are drawn by S.counter and priceTags, not listed under lettering.

Only four narration gaps are 0.3 s or longer (9.16-9.52, 21.34-21.84, 122.24-122.66, 169.06-169.58), so the film has five effects in total (the fifth after the last word). Do not add more; BANG! and KNOCK! are lettering only.
Set LIFE.t = t each frame so everyone blinks; give every character a gaze target in every scene (speaker and listener look at each other, everyone looks at a balloon when it pops).
S8 and S17 must share the brothers' seated and praying poses (define them once as constants, e.g. PRAY = {handL, handR, gaze}) so the payoff copies the setup.
The S8 empty-hands beat is the hinge of the film: keep the brothers completely still from 78.06 to 83.9 except blinks, and let only Said's eyes move.

Letter flashback (S14, S15): draw the world, then letterFrame in panel space; the match cuts in and out are on the open letter in Said's hands at the same panel position (letter rect about x 380..600, y 560..800 at zoom 1.9 in S13).
saidStreet is one 1600 strip; S1 and S2 use camX 420 so their x values are panel-relative. Bake the static street per palette; the sky uses skyCycle with o.sky false on the set.
Creditors: three persons with different costumes, speeds and gestures; use stagger(i) and separate walk phases so they never move in unison.
Mules: walk only in S17 (one mule, GAIT.donkey stride); elsewhere they stand with ear, tail and head idles on different seeds.
Amount text uses commas, never dashes. Headlines 44 px or more, labels 28 px or more at 1280 x 720 scale. Lettering never covers a face.
Panel-only shake (template) for the door BANG at 108.48 and the counter landing at 155.06, 2 to 3 px, 0.2 s.
THE END at 172.2; film length 174.9 s (duration 171.93 + 3.0 hold, rounded down to the frame).
warnings: The narration has almost no pauses; sound effects are limited to five.
The English translation is a summary and omits clauses in P4, P5, P6 and P8 (see owner_questions); English chunks therefore cannot track the Arabic exactly in those paragraphs.

Seven human characters plus the caliph: all are costume variants of the one Library person, distinguished by colour (Said green, Abdullah blue, Fadl navy, Jaafar red, creditors yellow/brown/blue-old). Keep these colours constant in clouds, balloons and medallions.
The person figure is front-facing only; walking in and out of doors relies on dir flips and the door leaf covering the figure.
